subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should `feishu_doc` create support optional initial markdown content by internally writing it, or should create remain title-only and reject `content` before document creation?
rationale: Both outcomes would fix the silent-drop bug, but they define different user-facing tool contracts and partial-failure behavior for a bundled Feishu plugin.

options.title: Support create-time content
options.body: Adopt a create-plus-write fix, preserve created document metadata or roll back on write failure, and require redacted live Feishu proof before landing.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Keep create title-only, fail before document creation when `content` is supplied, and update schema/docs/tests to make the two-step workflow explicit.

options.title: Defer to plugin owner
options.body: Pause the issue until the Feishu plugin owner confirms the preferred contract and proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Support create-time content
recommendation.body: Adopt a create-plus-write fix, preserve created document metadata or roll back on write failure, and require redacted live Feishu proof before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman merged the original Feishu Docx expansion and later changed the same create branch for requester grants, so they have the clearest current-main history for this contract choice.
